messages.content: You are a helpful assistant for a software development team.

We are building a FastAPI auth service. Here are the specs:
- JWT access tokens expire in 15 min
- Refresh tokens expire in 7 days
- Password reset tokens expire in 10 min
- Viewer role: 100 requests/min
- Editor role: 500 requests/min
- Admin role: unlimited requests

Confirmed, let's build it.
Got it. Building FastAPI auth service with those exact specs. Starting with the JWT implementation.
Add asyncpg for database connections.
Added asyncpg connection pool with async context manager.
Add Redis for token blacklisting.
Added Redis client with token blacklist methods.
Add SQLAlchemy models for users and roles.
Created User and Role models with relationship mapping.
Add Alembic for migrations.
Configured Alembic with async support and initial migration.
Add OpenTelemetry tracing.
Added OTLP exporter with span instrumentation on all endpoints.
Add Celery for background tasks.
Configured Celery with Redis broker and result backend.
Add structlog for structured logging.
Added structlog with JSON renderer and request correlation IDs.
Add API versioning under /v1.
Added APIRouter with /v1 prefix and version negotiation middleware.
Add Redis caching for frequent queries.
Added cache decorator with configurable TTL and invalidation hooks.
List every token expiry time and role-based rate limit we established at the start. Be exact with all numbers.
